QUOTE: "Every empty reply carries `scope` (file count, source tier, extensions, top levels, and `not_indexed` when recorded). That is the field that distinguishes "outside what was indexed" from "not in the repo.""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says scope lists extensions and `not_indexed` (file types not indexed), but never states that the reply names the in-scope file types that produced no rows. It also admits the "definitive" verdict does not compare against `not_indexed`.
